//: Copy this file to bridge/config.json and change what you need; every setting you leave out comes from
config.defaults.json, and a key that is not there is an error (keys starting with // are comments).
config.json may hold API keys: keep it out of git.
port: the extension's options page must use the same address (http://127.0.0.1:<port>).
storeDir: where translations are saved. Empty means the per-user data folder (Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\subpair,
macOS ~/Library/Application Support/subpair, Linux $XDG_DATA_HOME/subpair or ~/.local/share/subpair). A relative
path is relative to this folder (bridge/).
allowedOrigins: the browser extensions that may call the bridge. Empty allows any extension. To allow only Subpair,
list its origin: in Chrome "chrome-extension://<the ID shown on chrome://extensions>", in Firefox
//eztrans: Windows only. helper: Luna Translator's LunaSubProcess32.exe; dir: the ezTrans XP folder; cwd: the Luna Translator folder.
//api: Anthropic API. The key can also come from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max; empty leaves it out (models that do not take it).
//openai: Any OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. The key can also come from OPENAI_API_KEY; servers on this computer or the local network usually need none.
